Container.Name: qui-sync

Branch.TagDescription: Development builds, for testing only. May contain bugs and breaking changes.

Container.Overview: qui-sync: manage Qui automations as code. Export rules from your Qui instances to a versioned git repo, and subscribe to other repos to import their rules into your Qui. Your trackers, enabled state, and intervals are preserved on sync. Web UI on port 6070. EARLY DEVELOPMENT, for testing only.
Container.Changes:
### 2026-06-07 - First public listing on Community Apps. qui-sync is in early development and ships only on the `:dev` channel. No `:latest` yet, no automatic promotion until the project leaves early development. Backup your Qui rules before you try Subscribe.
Per-release notes: https://github.com/ProphetSe7en/qui-sync/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
Container.Requires: A running Qui instance. Everything is configured from the web UI, no manual file editing needed.
